description: Preserve critical project context before automatic compaction

hooks.command: PROJECT_DIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}"; OUTPUT=''; if [ -f "$PROJECT_DIR/.claude/context-essentials.md" ]; then ESSENTIALS=$(head -100 "$PROJECT_DIR/.claude/context-essentials.md"); OUTPUT="CRITICAL CONTEXT TO PRESERVE:\n\n$ESSENTIALS"; fi; if [ -n "$OUTPUT" ]; then jq -n --arg msg "$OUTPUT" '{"systemMessage": $msg}'; else echo '{}'; fi; exit 0

usage: Copy the PreCompact hook to .claude/settings.json or your profile settings.json. Create .claude/context-essentials.md with your project's critical context (architecture decisions, conventions, current tasks). This content will be re-injected before compaction to prevent loss of critical information. Requires jq.
